title: Value-carrying external call (solidity) — review required
description: A solidity contract sends value through an external call. The recipient can call back into this contract before its state updates, which allows re-entrant withdrawals. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms state is updated first and a reentrancy guard applies.
remediation: Update state before the external call, and use a reentrancy guard and checks-effects-interactions order.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: every value-carrying call matches. Re-entry needs control-flow review.
